description: Bat emergence — 30k agents, CCW vortex column exit from cave, echolocation repulsion rings, three-phase: queue / vortex / disperse.
reference: Betke et al. 2008 (tracking 20M bats); Gillam et al. 2007
notes: Mexican free-tailed bats emerge at dusk and spiral upward in a counter-clockwise column, maintaining echolocation-based personal space bubbles (radius ~30cm). Phase 0=pre-emergence queue; 1=vortex column; 2=foraging dispersal.
